cv.name: Margaux Vasseur
cv.headline: Product Manager – B2B SaaS, logistics & field operations
cv.summary: Product manager with six years in B2B SaaS, the last four owning field-operations products for logistics customers. I work closely with engineering and design on discovery, prioritise with data and like shipping small increments often.

experience.title: Product Manager
bullets: Own the mobile driver app and dispatch module used by 12,000 drivers across 140 customers
Led discovery and launch of proof-of-delivery with photo and e-signature, now used in 70% of deliveries
Define quarterly OKRs with the engineering lead and run roadmap reviews with sales and support
Introduced a continuous discovery routine with fortnightly customer interviews

experience.title: Product Owner
bullets: Managed the backlog for a warehouse management module in a Scrum team of eight
Reduced support tickets on inventory counts by 25% after redesigning the counting flow

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Wrote functional specifications for ERP integrations at mid-sized manufacturers

skills: Product discovery, user interviews, opportunity solution trees
certifications: Professional Scrum Product Owner I (PSPO I)
